column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline — passive-scan rule tuning (OSE-1186 G2).
# CALIBRATION CONTRACT. This file starts intentionally empty of IGNOREs. The
# first run enumerates the TRUE alert profile against the local Worker; the
# job reports every WARN loudly (artifact + job summary) but only *fails* on a
# FAIL-level alert (see dast-zap-baseline.yml exit-code policy). Once the first
# run's warnings are triaged, a real finding is promoted to FAIL here and a
# genuine-false-positive (e.g. an http://localhost-only artifact that is
# handled in prod over HTTPS) is set to IGNORE — each with a written reason.
# Nothing is masked silently: an IGNORE without a reason comment is a review
# smell, the same way a skipped test is.
# The Worker already emits CSP (nonce-based), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-
# so those "header missing" passive rules should PASS, not warn — a warning on
# any of them is a real regression, not noise.
# (no rule overrides yet — calibrate from the first run)
